concept.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original Runelord character base: Pleatcap Matriarch, a hostile fungal organism. One enormous drooping asymmetrical bell-shaped mushroom cap in muted indigo with scalloped pale bone rim, wide bold gills beneath. Thick ochre stalk splits into TWO broad bent walking lobes firmly planted apart. TWO short folded fan-shaped fungal fronds beside stalk used to release spores. A severe horizontal sensory slit under cap, no human face. Low heavy broad triangular silhouette, no gear or humanoid hands, no tiny mushrooms clutter. Neutral combat stance facing left shallow three-quarter game view, all limbs separated, full silhouette generous margins, genuine transparent background. Approved supplied Runelord artwork is STYLE ONLY. Tough serious exaggerated graphic 2D shapes, broad flat color planes, crisp hard-edged cel shadows, restrained highlights, few large nicks. Keep quiet surfaces and few readable gill lines. Avoid cute mascot, realistic fungus texture, painterly gradients, dense grunge, PBR/3D, scenery, text, ground shadow; at least 1024 long edge.

style_lock.direction: Preserve approved identity and serious clean 2D cel shading
